d: Stanzino decorated with good taste, corresponding to a vegetable garden that can be seen from the middle door. Two side doors, side chairs and tables. Amaranto and various young friends of his occupied in various jobs, dressed in clothes not less capricious than elegant.
Say, Sunflower with a big cardboard box.
Amaranto, then the Colonnella, who comes from the door missing.
Square. At the bottom door of the city. On one side home of the Generala with two Sentinels at the door, the Helper, and Soldate, in the south of Girasole.
Sunflower, turn to the Colonnella.
Having said that, then the Helper from the door: then the General preceded by the army of Soldate followed by the Count and the Marchesa who remain behind.
Say, minus the Colonnella.
The Marquis alone.

Magnificent hall of the Generala's house with door in the middle corresponding to the Count's apartments. Amaranto with a work bag hung on his arm, then Girasole with basket under his arm. Amaranto comes out fresh with the fan, walks and works.
Sunflower, then the Count moves on with several damsel to finish dressing him.
Said, and the Marchioness.
The Marquis alone.

Garden. At the end of the Count's apartment with workable door. Laterally also workable loggia. On the right a bush, a fountain is missing. In the middle a statue. On one side at the bottom rake from which comes out of the garden. Marchesa that leaves the apartment and two Damigelli that accompany it to the door. Then the Help.
Dice and the Count.
The Count, then the Colonel.
Said and Amaranto from the apartment.
Says and sunflowers.
The Colonel, Amaranto, the Count then the General.
The Colonna, Amaranto, the Count, and Schiara.

Atrium in the retreat of the Casti Colombi, with practicable door in the middle placed on various steps. The Count and Amaranto. Soldiers around, that at the rise of the tent some steps are advanced, and all at once beat the rod on the ground.
Say, Colonnella, Generala and Girasole.
Said, the Great Dove and the Dove Castes.

Piazzetta dell'Arsenale. In a corner at the bottom of the forge where all kinds of weapons are worked. In the middle drawbridge with Sentinels from here and there. In the square mountains of large iron balls, cannons, bombs, etc. La Generala and choir of Fabbre, starts working in the forge, part of the door.
Delle and Girasole.
Said, then the Colonnella.
These and the Commander from the bridge accompanied by various officers advance to the sound of a march.
Those.
The lonely helper.
General Chamber with drawings of fortifications. Bomb patterns, etc. Above a table fiasco of wine and lights. Generala smokes with some Officers.
That's why he smokes and drinks and helps.
Said glue pipe to the mouth and with the glass in hand and the Count.
The Count, the Colonel.
The Count, the General.
Garden. At the bottom of the Count's apartment. On one side loggias with grills that can be raised, on the other rake. Amaranto on the loggia, then the Marchioness from the rake singing and working.

Baths crumbled among the ruins of which you can see the sea. Night, and moon. Two boats at the bottom and various Barcaiuole singing the following choir; then the Colonnella, the Count, then Amaranto and the Marchesa, all hastily.
Say, General and Soldier.
The colonel alone.
The Help with Soldiers and Sunflowers, then the Marchioness.

Said, the General and the Count dressed in dress all adorned with garlands of flowers, with long trail, which will be supported by a Paggia, Amaranto, Damigelli, Feminine People, who remain behind; then the Great Dove, and the White Doves.
The Colonna unarmed and said.
The General, the Colonnella, Amaranto, the Helper, the Great Columbus, the feminine people and soldiers.
Amaranto and Damigelli.

Beach of the sea. Night. On one side walls crenellated with closed door of the city. In some eminence, from which you descend on the beach. On the other side grove, bordering the sea. The walls are garnished with Soldate, and cannons, which make fire. On the sea ships that bomb the city. Soldiers on the ships, then the Colonnella, the Generala, the Helpanta, then the Commander.
Told them, the Count and the Marchioness who run and stand between the two armies.
Detti and Amaranto from the city gate covered by a long veil followed by Girasole.
